extern function :: sin
extern function :: cos

begin function (u,v,A_up1_up1,A_up2_up2,A_up1_up2,J,mass,square,active) = init()
  double [] :: u, v, A_up1_up1, A_up2_up2, A_up1_up2, J, mass, square, active
  A_up1_up1[i,j] = R * parallel * r**(-1) * cos(angle + twist * sin(dtheta * i))**2 + R * perpendicular * r**(-1) * sin(angle + twist * sin(dtheta * i))**2 + parallel * cos(angle + twist * sin(dtheta * i))**2 * cos(dtheta * i) + perpendicular * sin(angle + twist * sin(dtheta * i))**2 * cos(dtheta * i)
  A_up2_up2[i,j] = ((-1) * perpendicular * r * sin(angle + twist * sin(dtheta * i))**2 + parallel * r * sin(angle + twist * sin(dtheta * i))**2 + perpendicular * r) / (R + r * cos(dtheta * i))
  A_up1_up2[i,j] = (-1) * perpendicular * cos(angle + twist * sin(dtheta * i)) * sin(angle + twist * sin(dtheta * i)) + parallel * cos(angle + twist * sin(dtheta * i)) * sin(angle + twist * sin(dtheta * i))
  J[i,j] = R * r + r**2 * cos(dtheta * i)
  u[i,j] = if stimulus > 0 then if (cos(dphi * j) > (19 / 20)) * (cos(dtheta * i) > 0) * (sin(dphi * j) > 0) then 2 else (-1) * beta else if stimulus < 0 then (-1) * beta else 1 + cos(dphi * j) * sin(dtheta * i)
  v[i,j] = if stimulus > 0 then if (sin(dphi * j) < 0) * (cos(dphi * j) > (4 / 5)) * (cos(dtheta * i) > 0) then 2 else (-3) * beta + beta**3 else if stimulus < 0 then (-3) * beta + beta**3 else 0
  mass[i,j] = R * cell * r * (if stimulus > 0 then if (cos(dphi * j) > (19 / 20)) * (cos(dtheta * i) > 0) * (sin(dphi * j) > 0) then 2 else (-1) * beta else if stimulus < 0 then (-1) * beta else 1 + cos(dphi * j) * sin(dtheta * i)) + cell * r**2 * cos(dtheta * i) * (if stimulus > 0 then if (cos(dphi * j) > (19 / 20)) * (cos(dtheta * i) > 0) * (sin(dphi * j) > 0) then 2 else (-1) * beta else if stimulus < 0 then (-1) * beta else 1 + cos(dphi * j) * sin(dtheta * i))
  square[i,j] = R * cell * r * (if stimulus > 0 then if (cos(dphi * j) > (19 / 20)) * (cos(dtheta * i) > 0) * (sin(dphi * j) > 0) then 2 else (-1) * beta else if stimulus < 0 then (-1) * beta else 1 + cos(dphi * j) * sin(dtheta * i))**2 + cell * r**2 * (if stimulus > 0 then if (cos(dphi * j) > (19 / 20)) * (cos(dtheta * i) > 0) * (sin(dphi * j) > 0) then 2 else (-1) * beta else if stimulus < 0 then (-1) * beta else 1 + cos(dphi * j) * sin(dtheta * i))**2 * cos(dtheta * i)
  active[i,j] = if stimulus == 0 then if 1 + cos(dphi * j) * sin(dtheta * i) > 0 then R * cell * r + cell * r**2 * cos(dtheta * i) else 0 else if (stimulus > 0) * (cos(dphi * j) > (19 / 20)) * (cos(dtheta * i) > 0) * (sin(dphi * j) > 0) then R * cell * r + cell * r**2 * cos(dtheta * i) else 0
end function

begin function (u',v',A_up1_up1',A_up2_up2',A_up1_up2',J',mass',square',active') = step(u,v,A_up1_up1,A_up2_up2,A_up1_up2,J,mass,square,active)
  double [] :: u', v', A_up1_up1', A_up2_up2', A_up1_up2', J', mass', square', active'
  A_up1_up1'[i,j] = A_up1_up1[i,j]
  A_up2_up2'[i,j] = A_up2_up2[i,j]
  A_up1_up2'[i,j] = A_up1_up2[i,j]
  J'[i,j] = J[i,j]
  p_down1[i,j] = (u[i+1,j] + (-1) * u[i,j]) / dtheta
  p_down2[i,j] = (u[i,j+1] + (-1) * u[i,j]) / dphi
  q_up1[i,j] = p_down1[i,j] * ((1 / 2) * A_up1_up1[i,j] + (1 / 2) * A_up1_up1[i+1,j]) + ((1 / 2) * A_up1_up2[i,j] + (1 / 2) * A_up1_up2[i+1,j]) * ((1 / 4) * p_down2[i,j-1] + (1 / 4) * p_down2[i,j] + (1 / 4) * p_down2[i+1,j-1] + (1 / 4) * p_down2[i+1,j])
  q_up2[i,j] = p_down2[i,j] * ((1 / 2) * A_up2_up2[i,j] + (1 / 2) * A_up2_up2[i,j+1]) + ((1 / 2) * A_up1_up2[i,j] + (1 / 2) * A_up1_up2[i,j+1]) * ((1 / 4) * p_down1[i-1,j] + (1 / 4) * p_down1[i-1,j+1] + (1 / 4) * p_down1[i,j] + (1 / 4) * p_down1[i,j+1])
  u'[i,j] = u[i,j] + (-1) * dt * reaction * v[i,j] + (-1) * dt * reaction * u[i,j]**3 + 3 * dt * reaction * u[i,j] + dt * (q_up1[i,j] + (-1) * q_up1[i-1,j]) / dtheta * J[i,j]**(-1) + dt * (q_up2[i,j] + (-1) * q_up2[i,j-1]) / dphi * J[i,j]**(-1)
  v'[i,j] = v[i,j] + beta * dt * eps * reaction + dt * eps * reaction * u[i,j]
  mass'[i,j] = cell * J[i,j] * u'[i,j]
  square'[i,j] = cell * J[i,j] * u'[i,j]**2
  active'[i,j] = if u'[i,j] > 0 then cell * J[i,j] else 0
end function
反応を止めた拡散の検査では、∫u dA の変化は最大 1.64e−11、∫u² dA は減少。 一様な静止状態の最大誤差は 2.00e−15。 滑らかな関数に対する空間差分の 2次精度を確認しました（格子幅を半分にすると二乗誤差が約1/16）。 時間ブロッキングの有無、およびθ・φそれぞれの方向に2分割するMPI実行で、全格子値が一致しました。
再生成：make excitable_torus-demo → python examples/excitable_torus/render.py --video。 追加検証：make excitable_torus-verify。 描画環境・実行手順・ 検証数値と実行環境

トーラス上のネマティック液晶 — 曲率で仕分けられる欠陥

ネマティック液晶は、分子の向きだけがそろい位置は無秩序な液晶です。 向きを表す秩序テンソル Qij（対称・トレース 0）をドーナツ形の曲面の上で緩和させます。 向きの場が半回転する特異点（±1/2 の欠陥）は対で生まれて対消滅し、その途中で +1/2 は外側（ガウス曲率が正）へ、 −1/2 は穴側（ガウス曲率が負）へ寄ります。閉曲面では欠陥の電荷の総和はオイラー標数（トーラスでは 0）に等しいので、必ず対で現れます。

左：滑らかな擬似乱数の向きの場から出発（欠陥が多数）。中央：+1/2 を外側、−1/2 を穴側に置いた曲率に好まれる配置。 右：その逆の配置。色は秩序 |Q|²（欠陥の芯で 0）、白い線分は向き、● は +1/2、◆ は −1/2 の欠陥です。 上段は曲面、下段は同じ値の展開図。120×240 格子、Δt = 0.00375、t = 0 → 60 の実際の計算結果です。 欠陥数・外側の偏り・自由エネルギー・ 動画ファイル
∂tQij = L gkl∇k∇lQij + (a − c QmnQmn) Qij
∇kQij = ∂kQij + ΓikmQmj + ΓjkmQim， Γijk = ½ gil(∂jglk + ∂kglj − ∂lgjk)
∇ は共変微分（曲がった座標でテンソルを微分するときに、計量の 1 階微分から決まる接続係数 Γ を足す微分）。 L=1、a=c=1、R=12、r=6、gij=diag(r², (R+r cos θ)²)。上下で繰り返す添字は和を取ります。

接続係数 Γ は Egison が計量の記号微分から導き、static field として初期化時に保存し、以後は自動で保持します。 テンソルの共変ラプラシアンは、各成分の Laplace–Beltrami 作用素と Γ を含む接続項に分けて添字記法で書きます。 christoffel は引数なしで定義したテンソル値で、christoffel~i_1_l . Q~l~j のように添字を付けて Q との縮約に使います。 欠陥は、向きを 2 倍したベクトルが各格子のまわりで何回転するかを差分の恒等式から厳密に数えて検出し（atan2 を使いません）、 個数・外側にある個数・自由エネルギー・|Q|²・トレース・対称性の残差をすべて Formurae で集計します。

Formurae ソース全文(nematic_torus.fme・118 行) 
-- Nematic liquid crystal on a torus: relaxation of the contravariant order
-- tensor Q^{ij} (symmetric, traceless) under the Landau--de Gennes energy.
-- The covariant derivative uses the Christoffel symbols that Egison derives
-- from the metric; the connection terms are contracted with index notation.
-- theta circles the tube; phi circles the hole. Both are periodic.
dimension 2
axes θ, φ
metric g
metric scale [r, R + r * cos θ]

param R = 12.0
param r = 6.0
param dt = 0.005
param L = 1.0
param a = 1.0
param c = 1.0
param seed = 1.0
param arrangement = 0.0
param cell = dtheta * dphi
param htheta = dtheta
param hphi = dphi
extern sqrt

-- Christoffel symbols of the metric, stored in static fields at initialization
def gamma = withSymbols [i, j, k, l] ((g~i~l . (∂/∂ g_l_k coordinates~j + ∂/∂ g_l_j coordinates~k - ∂/∂ g_j_k coordinates~l)) / 2)
def gammaTheta = withSymbols [j, k] (gamma~1_j_k)
def gammaPhi = withSymbols [j, k] (gamma~2_j_k)
def christoffel = [| G1_j_k, G2_j_k |]~i_j_k
-- covariant derivative components of a rank-2 contravariant tensor
def covTheta Q~a~b = withSymbols [i, j, l] (∂_θ Q~i~j + christoffel~i_1_l . Q~l~j + christoffel~j_1_l . Q~i~l)
def covPhi Q~a~b = withSymbols [i, j, l] (∂_φ Q~i~j + christoffel~i_2_l . Q~l~j + christoffel~j_2_l . Q~i~l)
-- Laplace--Beltrami of one component, and the connection terms that complete
-- the covariant Laplacian g^{kl} ∇_k ∇_l Q^{ij} of the tensor.  Every
-- coefficient that depends on the position (metric, inverse metric, the
-- derivatives of volume * g^{kk}) is stored in a static field at initialization
-- and automatically retained in subsequent steps.
def lb F = w1 * ∂^2_θ F + w2 * ∂^2_φ F + c1 * ∂_θ F + c2 * ∂_φ F
def connection Q~a~b D1~c~d D2~e~f = withSymbols [i, j, m, n] (w1 * (∂_θ (christoffel~i_1_m . Q~m~j + christoffel~j_1_m . Q~i~m) - christoffel~m_1_1 . (christoffel~i_m_n . Q~n~j + christoffel~j_m_n . Q~i~n) + christoffel~i_1_m . D1~m~j + christoffel~j_1_m . D1~i~m) + w2 * (∂_φ (christoffel~i_2_m . Q~m~j + christoffel~j_2_m . Q~i~m) - christoffel~m_2_2 . (christoffel~i_m_n . Q~n~j + christoffel~j_m_n . Q~i~n) + christoffel~i_2_m . D2~m~j + christoffel~j_2_m . D2~i~m))
def norm2 Q~a~b = withSymbols [i, j, k, l] (GD_i_k . GD_j_l . Q~i~j . Q~k~l)
def gradient2 D1~a~b D2~c~d = w1 * norm2 D1 + w2 * norm2 D2
def traceless T~a~b = withSymbols [i, j, k, l] (T~i~j - GU~i~j * (GD_k_l . T~k~l) / 2)
-- initial doubled director (mx, my) = S (cos 2α, sin 2α) in the orthonormal frame:
-- seed = 1 takes a smooth pseudo-random vector field whose zeros are the defects;
-- seed = 0 places four defects, +1/2 on the outer side (arrangement = 1) or inner side (-1)
def doubledX = seed * (sin (3 * θ + 1) * cos (2 * φ) + cos (5 * φ + 2 * θ + 0.5)) + (1 - seed) * cos φ
def doubledY = seed * (sin (θ - 4 * φ + 2) + cos (3 * θ + 7 * φ - 1) * sin (2 * θ)) + (1 - seed) * arrangement * sin θ * sin φ
def doubledNorm = sqrt (doubledX^2 + doubledY^2 + 0.01)
def initial = withSymbols [i, j] ([| [| doubledX / (2 * g_1_1), doubledY / (2 * volume) |], [| doubledY / (2 * volume), 0 - doubledX / (2 * g_2_2) |] |]~i~j / doubledNorm)
-- exact one-cell shifts from compact differences (the LBM pull identity),
-- and branch-cut crossings of the doubled director along an edge.  The
-- winding number is counted on the two triangles that meet at a grid point,
-- (i,j)->(i+1,j)->(i,j+1) and (i,j)->(i-1,j)->(i,j-1), which tile the torus
-- and read only the four axis neighbours, so every update stays within one cell.
def shift c q = q + c * htheta * ∂_θ q + htheta^2 * ∂^2_θ q / 2
def shiftPhi c q = q + c * hphi * ∂_φ q + hphi^2 * ∂^2_φ q / 2
def crossing ax ay bx by = if ay >= 0 && by < 0 && ax * by - bx * ay > 0 then 1 else (if ay < 0 && by >= 0 && ax * by - bx * ay < 0 then -1 else 0)

field Q~i~j @ collocated
static field G1{_j_k} @ collocated := gammaTheta
static field G2{_j_k} @ collocated := gammaPhi
static field GD{_i_j} @ collocated := g_i_j
static field GU{~i~j} @ collocated := g~i~j
static field J : scalar @ collocated := volume
static field w1 : scalar @ collocated := inverseMetric~1~1
static field w2 : scalar @ collocated := inverseMetric~2~2
static field c1 : scalar @ collocated := (∂/∂ (volume * inverseMetric~1~1) θ) / volume
static field c2 : scalar @ collocated := (∂/∂ (volume * inverseMetric~2~2) φ) / volume
static field outer : scalar @ collocated := if cos θ > 0 then 1 else 0
field order : scalar @ collocated
field energy : scalar @ collocated
field winding : scalar @ collocated
field plus : scalar @ collocated
field minus : scalar @ collocated
field plusOuter : scalar @ collocated
field minusOuter : scalar @ collocated
field tr : scalar @ collocated
field asym : scalar @ collocated

init:
  Q~i~j := initial
  order := 0
  energy := 0
  winding := 0
  plus := 0
  minus := 0
  plusOuter := 0
  minusOuter := 0
  tr := 0
  asym := 0

step:
  local D1~i~j @ collocated = covTheta Q
  local D2~i~j @ collocated = covPhi Q
  local Lw~i~j @ collocated = connection Q D1 D2
  local Qn~i~j @ collocated = Q~i~j + dt * (L * (Lw~i~j + [| [| lb Q~1~1, lb Q~1~2 |], [| lb Q~2~1, lb Q~2~2 |] |]~i~j) + (a - c * norm2 Q) * Q~i~j)
  Q'~i~j = traceless Qn
  order' = norm2 Q'
  tr' = GD_1_1 * Q'~1~1 + GD_2_2 * Q'~2~2
  asym' = Q'~1~2 - Q'~2~1
  -- The energy and the defect windings are evaluated on the state entering
  -- the step, so that every update reads at most two cells away and the
  -- temporal-blocking halo stays exact.
  energy' = cell * J * (L * gradient2 D1 D2 / 2 - a * norm2 Q / 2 + c * (norm2 Q)^2 / 4)
  local mx = GD_1_1 * Q~1~1 - GD_2_2 * Q~2~2
  local my = 2 * J * Q~1~2
  local mxp = shift 1 mx
  local myp = shift 1 my
  local mxm = shift (-1) mx
  local mym = shift (-1) my
  local mxq = shiftPhi 1 mx
  local myq = shiftPhi 1 my
  local mxr = shiftPhi (-1) mx
  local myr = shiftPhi (-1) my
  winding' = crossing mx my mxp myp + crossing mxp myp mxq myq + crossing mxq myq mx my + crossing mx my mxm mym + crossing mxm mym mxr myr + crossing mxr myr mx my
  plus' = if winding' > 0 then winding' else 0
  minus' = if winding' < 0 then 0 - winding' else 0
  plusOuter' = if winding' > 0 && outer > 0.5 then winding' else 0
  minusOuter' = if winding' < 0 && outer > 0.5 then 0 - winding' else 0

random（120×240 格子、t = 0 → 60）では、t = 6 に 20 対あった欠陥が t = 60 に 7 対まで対消滅し、 残った +1/2 は 7 個すべてが外側、−1/2 は 7 個すべてが穴側に落ち着きました（t = 15 の時点で +1/2 は 10/10 が外側、−1/2 は 2/10 が外側）。 favored の 4 欠陥は位置を変えずに残り（自由エネルギー −680）、disfavored の 4 欠陥も t = 60 まで残りますが自由エネルギーは −629 と高く、曲率と反対の配置が準安定であることを示します。 自由エネルギーは三つの場合とも単調に減少し、Q の対称性の残差は厳密に 0、トレースは 1e−15 以下、+1/2 と −1/2 の個数は常に等しく、 時間ブロッキングの有無で全格子値が一致しました。
再生成：make nematic_torus-demo → python examples/nematic_torus/render.py --video。 追加検証：make nematic_torus-verify（勾配流・対称性・電荷中性・ブロッキングと MPI の一致・共変ラプラシアンの 2 次収束：格子を半分にするごとに二乗誤差が 15.8 倍、15.9 倍小さくなる）。 説明と実行手順・ 検証数値と実行環境

座標変換を物質に読み替える — クロークと場の回転子

Maxwell 方程式は一般座標で共変です。平面の座標変換を施すと、変換後の空間で真空だった方程式は、 元の直交格子の上では「異方的な透磁率・誘電率をもつ物質中の方程式」と同じ形になります（変換光学）。 この対応を使って、導体円柱を見えなくするクロークと、内側の波面を一定角度だけ回す回転子を、 通常の Yee 格子（電場と磁場を半セルずらす配置）で計算します。

左上：真空の参照パルス。右上：裸の導体円柱（影と反射）。左下：打ち切りクローク（写像 r′ = R2 (r − R1′)/(R2 − R1′)）。 右下：四分の一回転の回転子（写像 φ′ = φ + f(r)）。色は面外電場 Ez。波長 2、320×240 格子（1 波長 40 格子）の実際の計算結果です。 散乱率とエネルギーの時間変化・ 動画ファイル
∂tEz = εz−1(∂xHy − ∂yHx)， ∂tB = −∇×E， Hi = (μ−1)ijBj
μij = √g gij，εz = √g，(μ−1)ij = gij/√g
g は座標変換の引き戻し計量。極座標の正規直交枠 (r̂, φ̂) で、回転子は g = [[1+s², s], [s, 1]]（s = r f′(r)、det g = 1）、 クロークは g = diag(h′², (r′/r)²)（h′ = R2/(R2 − R1′)）です。プログラムはこれらを書かず、写像から導きます。

プログラムに書くのは座標変換そのもので、物質テンソルは Egison が導きます。回転子の写像を ∂/∂ で微分して Jacobian を作り、添字記法の縮約で引き戻し計量にします： def rotatedJacobian = withSymbols [k, i] (∂/∂ rotated~k coordinates~i)、 def rotatedMetric = withSymbols [i, j, k] (rotatedJacobian~k_i . rotatedJacobian_k_j)。 手で書くのは体積要素 √g（回転子は 1、クロークは h′r′/r）だけです。 Yee 配置では Hx と By の位置が違うので、resample で同じ位置へそろえてから縮約します。 真空の参照解を同じプログラムの中で同時に時間発展させ、装置の外側での散乱エネルギーの比を生成したソルバー内で積分します。 電場を双対格子、磁場を主格子に置くと、一つの更新は前向きに 2 格子・後ろ向きに 1 格子を読み、Formura はこの前向きの到達距離で袖領域を取るため、時間ブロッキングと MPI 分割の結果が単一プロセスの結果と一致します。

Formurae ソース全文(transformation_optics.fme・127 行) 
-- Transformation optics: TE Maxwell (Ez, Bx, By) on a Cartesian Yee grid.
-- A coordinate map of the plane is realized as an anisotropic material with
-- mu^{ij} = sqrt(g) g^{ij} and eps_z = sqrt(g), where g is the metric of the
-- map pulled back to the physical plane (Ward and Pendry).  The map is the
-- only input: Egison differentiates it into the Jacobian, contracts the
-- Jacobian into the pulled-back metric and divides by the volume element,
-- all in index notation.  The vacuum reference (Ev, Bv) runs in the same program
-- so the scattered field is measured inside the generated solver.
-- z is a dummy periodic axis that carries the Yee (edge/face) placements.
-- E lives on the dual grid and B, H on the primal grid: H = mu^{-1} B
-- interpolates the new B to the other edge, B' reads E' one cell back and
-- E' reads H one cell ahead, so an update reaches two cells forward and one
-- cell backward.  Formura sizes the halo by the forward reach, which is why
-- this placement (and not the mirrored one) blocks and decomposes exactly.
-- H is kept as a field so that the E update does not go through the interpolation.
dimension 3
axes x, y, z
metric g

param dt = 0.1 * dx
param x0 = 3.0
-- the device centre sits a quarter cell off the nodes, edges and cell centres, so no
-- sample of the frame vectors or of 1/eps_z falls on the singular point r = 0
param cx = 8.0 + 0.25 * dx
param cy = 6.0 + 0.25 * dy
param width = 3.0
param wavenumber = 3.141592653589793
param R1 = 1.0
param R2 = 2.0
param R1s = 0.9
param twist = 0.7853981633974483
param cloak = 0.0
param rotator = 0.0
param obstacle = 0.0
param cell = dx * dy
extern sqrt
extern exp

-- The shifted coordinates are quoted (backquote) so that the CAS keeps them as
-- atoms: expanding (x - cx)^2 + (y - cy)^2 inside every root and product would
-- make the differentiation of the maps below take minutes instead of seconds.
def u = `(x - cx)
def v = `(y - cy)
def rr = sqrt (u^2 + v^2)
def shell = if rr > R1 && rr < R2 then 1 else 0
def core = if rr < R1 then 1 else 0
-- The solver uses H = mu^{-1} B with mu^{-1}_{ij} = g_{ij} / sqrt(g).  Each map
-- sends a physical point to its image in the virtual (vacuum) plane; it is the
-- identity outside the shell R1 < r < R2 and is only used inside it.
-- rotator: (r, phi) -> (r, phi + twist (R2 - r)/(R2 - R1)), a rotation by an angle
-- that decreases from twist at R1 to zero at R2 (det g = 1, eps_z = 1).
def angle = twist * (R2 - rr) / (R2 - R1)
def rotated = [| cx + u * cos angle - v * sin angle, cy + u * sin angle + v * cos angle, z |]
-- cloak: r -> r' = R2 (r - R1s)/(R2 - R1s) with phi unchanged (R1s < R1 keeps every
-- value finite); sqrt(g) = h' r'/r with h' = R2/(R2 - R1s).
def stretch = R2 / (R2 - R1s)
def image = stretch * (rr - R1s)
def stretched = [| cx + image * u / rr, cy + image * v / rr, z |]
-- the Jacobian J^k_i of each map and its pulled-back metric g_ij = J^k_i J^k_j;
-- the two maps are differentiated separately so that no product of their terms
-- appears (the flags rotator and cloak are symbols during normalization)
def rotatedJacobian = withSymbols [k, i] (∂/∂ rotated~k coordinates~i)
def rotatedMetric = withSymbols [i, j, k] (rotatedJacobian~k_i . rotatedJacobian_k_j)
def stretchedJacobian = withSymbols [k, i] (∂/∂ stretched~k coordinates~i)
def stretchedMetric = withSymbols [i, j, k] (stretchedJacobian~k_i . stretchedJacobian_k_j)
-- sqrt(det g): 1 for the rotator and h' r'/r for the cloak.  This is the one line
-- written by hand: det g is the square of h' r'/r, but the CAS does not take the
-- root of a perfect square that contains a square root itself.
def volumeElement = 1 + cloak * (stretch * image / rr - 1)
def permittivity = 1 + shell * (volumeElement - 1)
def inversePermittivity = (1 - core * obstacle) / permittivity
-- mu^{-1}_ij = g_ij / sqrt(g) inside the shell and the identity g^{ij} elsewhere,
-- one tensor per device; the device is selected in the step by the flags so
-- that the two maps never meet in one expression during normalization
def rotatorMaterial = withSymbols [i, j] (shell * rotatedMetric~i~j + (1 - shell) * g~i~j)
def cloakMaterial = withSymbols [i, j] (shell * stretchedMetric~i~j / volumeElement + (1 - shell) * g~i~j)
def pulse = exp (0 - ((x - x0) / width)^2) * cos (wavenumber * (x - x0))
-- the tail of the pulse must not be frozen inside the conductor, where E_z is held at zero
def masked = (1 - core * obstacle) * pulse
-- The material tensors are frozen into fields at init (they never change in
-- time); the step selects the device, resamples mu^{-1} to the placement of
-- each H component and contracts it with B.
def hx M~a~b V_c = withSymbols [j] (M~1~j . V_j)
def hy M~a~b V_c = withSymbols [j] (M~2~j . V_j)
def curlz H_c = ∂_x H_2 - ∂_y H_1
def ez V_c = V_3
def magnetic V_c W_d = withSymbols [i, j] (g~i~j . V_i . W_j)

field E_i @ dual
field B_i @ primal
field H_i @ primal
field Ev_i @ dual
field Bv_i @ primal
static field Mrot{~i~j} @ collocated := rotatorMaterial
static field Mcloak{~i~j} @ collocated := cloakMaterial
static field epsz : scalar @ collocated := permittivity
-- 1/eps_z sampled where E_z lives (the third component of a dual vector), so the
-- conductor mask stays sharp instead of being interpolated from the nodes
static field ie_i @ dual := [| 0, 0, inversePermittivity |]_i
static field outside : scalar @ collocated := if rr > R2 + 0.5 then cell else 0
field scatter : scalar @ collocated
field incident : scalar @ collocated
field energy : scalar @ collocated

init:
  E_i := [| 0, 0, masked |]_i
  B_i := [| 0, 0 - masked, 0 |]_i
  H_i := [| 0, 0 - masked, 0 |]_i
  Ev_i := [| 0, 0, pulse |]_i
  Bv_i := [| 0, 0 - pulse, 0 |]_i
  scatter := 0
  incident := 0
  energy := 0

step:
  local Minv{~i~j} @ collocated = rotator * Mrot~i~j + cloak * Mcloak~i~j + (1 - rotator - cloak) * g~i~j
  E'_i = [| 0, 0, E_3 + dt * ie_3 * curlz H |]_i
  B' = B - dt * curl E'
  H'_i = [| hx (resample(Minv, 1, 0, 0)) (resample(B', 1, 0, 0)), hy (resample(Minv, 0, 1, 0)) (resample(B', 0, 1, 0)), 0 |]_i
  Ev' = Ev + dt * curl Bv
  Bv' = Bv - dt * curl Ev'
  -- the difference is formed before squaring, so that the vacuum case measures the
  -- actual departure from the reference copy rather than cancellation error
  local diff @ collocated = ez (resample(E', 0, 0, 0)) - ez (resample(Ev', 0, 0, 0))
  scatter' = outside * diff^2
  incident' = outside * (ez (resample(Ev', 0, 0, 0)))^2
  energy' = cell * (epsz * (ez (resample(E', 0, 0, 0)))^2 + magnetic (resample(B', 0, 0, 0)) (resample(H', 0, 0, 0))) / 2

def FormuraeInternalEncodeScalar value := FEIR.encodeScalar feParameters feCoordinatesRegistry feFields feIntrinsics feAnalytics value
def FormuraeInternalEncodeTensor expectedShape variances degree value :=
  let actualVariances := Formurae.logicalTensorVariances value
      actualDegree := dfOrder value
      exactMetadata := actualVariances = variances && actualDegree = degree
      completesOmittedDownIndices := degree = 0
                                      && actualDegree > 0
                                      && actualVariances = variances
   in match assert "normalized equation tensor metadata mismatch"
                   (tensorShape value = expectedShape
                    && (exactMetadata || completesOmittedDownIndices)) as bool with
        | #True -> FEIR.encodeTensorWithMetadata feParameters feCoordinatesRegistry feFields feIntrinsics feAnalytics variances degree value

t = 10 における装置の外側（r > R2 + 0.5）の散乱率 ∫(Ez − Ezvac)²dA / ∫(Ezvac)²dA は、 真空で 10−32 以下（機械精度）、裸の円柱で 0.44、クロークで 0.15、回転子で 0.009。 電磁エネルギーは四つの場合とも 0.2% 以内で一定です。 半回転の回転子は物性値の異方性が極端になり（固有値比 100 超）、この解像度では散乱率 0.18 が残るため、標準設定は四分の一回転です。
再生成：make transformation_optics-demo → python examples/transformation_optics/render.py --video。 追加検証：make transformation_optics-verify（真空の散乱 0・エネルギー保存・装置間の散乱率比較・解像度依存・ブロッキングと MPI の一致）。 説明と実行手順・ 検証数値と実行環境

壁のある球殻の弾性波 — 球座標と非直交座標で同じプログラム

球面 R = 1 と R = 2 の間で余緯度 arctan 2 と π − arctan 2 の二つの円錐に挟まれた，赤道を取り巻く帯状の球殻で 線形弾性体の波（速度と応力）を計算します。壁はすべて剛体（速度を 0 に保つ）で，経度は周期的です。同じプログラムを，球座標と， 同じ球殻の非直交座標（経度が半径とともに巻く座標系，計量を成分で宣言）で実行します。λ = 2，μ = ρ0 = 1 なので P 波（圧縮波）の速さは 2，S 波（ずれの波）の速さは 1 で，経度方向を向く局所的な速度パルスは二つの殻に分かれ，S 波は壁で反射し， P 波は球殻を回ります。

97×65×256 格子（半径・余緯度の格子点数と経度のセル数）で波源を通る赤道面。赤は P 波の指標 a|∇·v|/V0， 青は S 波の指標 a|∇×v|/V0（平方根の色尺度，上限 0.2 と 0.5）。黒い円は壁 R = 1 と R = 2，破線円の半径は cPt と cSt，細線は 16 本ごとの格子線を物理位置に描いたもので，下段の経度の線は半径とともに巻きます。 第 3 列は構成関数に 1 項 αninjnknlekl（α = 3，n は半径方向）を加えたものです。
eij = ½(gik∂jvk + gjk∂ivk + (∂kgij)vk)， ∇jσij = (gik/J)∂j(Jgklσlj) − ½gik(∂kgjl)σjl， ∂tσij = Cijklekl，Cijkl = λgijgkl + μ(gikgjl + gilgjk)
座標は半径 r，余緯度 θ，および経度 Φ = φ + s(r − 1) に写される φ です（origin 宣言で r と θ を半径と余緯度そのものにします）。 計量は [[1 + (s r sin θ)², 0, s r² sin²θ], [0, r², 0], [s r² sin²θ, 0, r² sin²θ]]，√det g = r² sin θ で，二つの座標系の間で変わるのは パラメータ twist = s だけです。

三つの演算子は計量 g_i_j，逆計量 g~i~j，体積要素 volume，解析微分 ∂/∂ g_i_j coordinates~k をその場で使い， Egison がコンパイル時にこれらを展開・簡約し，生成された時間ステップは残った係数をセルの座標から評価します（計量を格納する配列はありません）。 boundary r : sbp，boundary θ : sbp が有界な軸に総和部分積分の差分を要求し，宣言が供給する定数（sbpLoR など）で 壁の格子点の速度をマスクします。力もマスクしてから速度に加えるので，1 ステップは内部の状態のシンプレクティックな写像です。 検証量はすべて `.fme` の場です：二つの波の指標，弾性エネルギーと速度 Verlet 法が保存する修正エネルギー，各殻の外側の半径 （指標が 0.01 を超える点の距離の max reduction），そしてねじれ振動の厳密なモード（3 次の球 Bessel 関数の動径部分と P31 の角度部分）に対する誤差。ドライバは起動と記録だけを行い，render.py は保存した赤道面の断面を物理位置に写して描きます。

Formurae ソース全文(elastic_shell.fme・126 行) 
-- Linear elastic waves (velocity-stress form) in a spherical shell with
-- rigid walls, written once for a family of coordinate systems.  The
-- coordinates are the radius r (from 1 to 2), the colatitude θ (from
-- arctan 2 to π - arctan 2, the band around the equator), and φ, which is
-- mapped to the longitude Φ = φ + twist * (r - 1): twist = 0 is spherical
-- coordinates, twist > 0 a non-orthogonal chart of the same shell whose
-- longitude lines wind with the radius.  The walls are coordinate surfaces
-- in every chart: the velocity vanishes on the spheres r = 1 and r = 2 and
-- on the two cones, and φ stays periodic.
--
-- The metric of the map is declared by its components.  The operators use
-- the metric, its inverse, and its analytic derivatives in place: Egison
-- differentiates and simplifies them at compile time, and the generated
-- time step evaluates the resulting coefficients from the cell coordinates.
-- With lambda = 2, mu = rho0 = 1 the P-wave speed is 2 and the S-wave
-- speed is 1.
dimension 3
axes r, θ, φ
origin r = 1.0
origin θ = 1.1071487177940906
metric g
metric tensor [[1 + (twist * r * sin θ)^2, 0, twist * (r * sin θ)^2], [0, r^2, 0], [twist * (r * sin θ)^2, 0, (r * sin θ)^2]]
metric volume r^2 * sin θ

boundary r : sbp
boundary θ : sbp

param λ = 2.0
param μ = 1.0
param ρ0 = 1.0
param dt = 0.05 * dr
param twist = 0.0
param radius = 0.25
param x0 = -1.5
param y0 = 0.0
param z0 = 0.0
param cell = dr * dθ * dφ
param front = 0.0001
extern exp
extern sqrt

-- physical position of a cell, and its physical distance from the source
-- (radius 1.5, colatitude pi/2, longitude pi)
def longitude = φ + twist * (r - 1)
def distance2 = (r * sin θ * cos longitude - x0)^2 + (r * sin θ * sin longitude - y0)^2 + (r * cos θ - z0)^2
-- the exponent is selected first, so that no overflowing value is formed;
-- the support stops at 0.995 radius (f < 1e-86 there), which keeps the
-- denominator positive under rounding of the expanded polynomials
def bump = if distance2 < 0.99 * radius^2 then 0 - 2 * distance2 / (radius^2 - distance2) else 0
def pulse = if distance2 < 0.99 * radius^2 then exp bump else 0
-- the expanded sums of squares can round to a small negative number, so the
-- square roots below are guarded
def distance = if distance2 < 0 then 0 else sqrt distance2
-- the summation-by-parts weight of a node: half on a wall
def weight = (if r < sbpLoR || r > sbpHiR then 0.5 else 1) * (if θ < sbpLoTheta || θ > sbpHiTheta then 0.5 else 1)
def strain V~a = withSymbols [i, j, k] ((g_i_k . ∂_j V~k + g_j_k . ∂_i V~k + (∂/∂ g_i_j coordinates~k) . V~k) / 2)
def stressRate E_i_j = withSymbols [i, j, k, l] (λ * g~i~j * (g~k~l . E_k_l) + 2 * μ * (g~i~k . g~j~l . E_k_l))
def stressDiv S~a~b = withSymbols [i, j, k, l] ((g~i~k . ∂_j (volume * (g_k_l . S~l~j))) / volume - (g~i~k . (∂/∂ g_j_l coordinates~k) . S~j~l) / 2)
-- coordinate-independent diagnostics of a velocity field
def waveDiv V~a = withSymbols [i] ((∂_i (volume * V~i)) / volume)
def waveCurl V~a = withSymbols [i, j, k, l] ((epsilon~i~j~k . ∂_j (g_k_l . V~l)) / volume)
def norm2 W~a = withSymbols [i, j] (g_i_j . W~i . W~j)
def stressNorm S~a~b = withSymbols [i, j, k, l] (g_i_k . g_j_l . S~i~j . S~k~l)
def stressTrace S~a~b = withSymbols [i, j] (g_i_j . S~i~j)

field v~i @ collocated
field σ{~i~j} @ collocated
field compression : scalar @ collocated
field shearing : scalar @ collocated
field energy : scalar @ collocated
field modified : scalar @ collocated
field pw : scalar @ collocated
field pr : scalar @ collocated
field sw : scalar @ collocated
field sr : scalar @ collocated
field pfront : scalar @ collocated
field sfront : scalar @ collocated

init:
  v~i := [| 0, 0, pulse / (r * sin θ) |]~i
  σ~i~j := [| [| 0, 0, 0 |], [| 0, 0, 0 |], [| 0, 0, 0 |] |]~i~j
  compression := 0
  shearing := 0
  energy := 0
  modified := 0
  pw := 0
  pr := 0
  sw := 0
  sr := 0
  pfront := 0
  sfront := 0

step:
  -- velocity Verlet: half velocity, full stress, half velocity; the mask
  -- clamps the velocity on the wall nodes of both bounded axes, which keeps
  -- the step a symplectic map of the interior state
  let wall = (if r < sbpLoR || r > sbpHiR then 0 else 1) * (if θ < sbpLoTheta || θ > sbpHiTheta then 0 else 1)
  let vm~i = [| wall, wall, wall |]~i
  local force~i @ collocated = stressDiv σ
  -- the force the step applies: zero on the walls
  local kick~i @ collocated = vm~i * force~i
  local half~i @ collocated = vm~i * v~i + (dt / (2 * ρ0)) * kick~i
  local strainRate{_i_j} @ collocated = strain half
  local rate{~i~j} @ collocated = stressRate strainRate
  σ'~i~j = σ~i~j + dt * rate~i~j
  local nextForce~i @ collocated = stressDiv σ'
  v'~i = vm~i * (half~i + (dt / (2 * ρ0)) * nextForce~i)
  -- diagnostics of the state entering the step: P-wave indicator (divergence),
  -- S-wave indicator (norm of the curl), elastic energy, the energy that the
  -- Verlet step preserves, the moments of the P and S shells, and the physical
  -- distance from the source of the farthest point where the dimensionless
  -- indicator exceeds sqrt(front) (the outer edge of each shell, which
  -- advances at the wave speed)
  local far @ collocated = distance
  compression' = waveDiv v
  local curlv~i @ collocated = waveCurl v
  local curl2 @ collocated = norm2 curlv
  shearing' = if curl2 < 0 then 0 else sqrt curl2
  energy' = weight * cell * volume * (ρ0 * norm2 v / 2 + stressNorm σ / (4 * μ) - λ * (stressTrace σ)^2 / (4 * μ * (3 * λ + 2 * μ)))
  modified' = energy' - weight * cell * volume * dt^2 * norm2 kick / (8 * ρ0)
  pw' = weight * cell * volume * compression'^2
  pr' = pw' * far
  sw' = weight * cell * volume * shearing'^2
  sr' = sw' * far
  pfront' = if radius^2 * compression'^2 > front then far else 0
  sfront' = if radius^2 * shearing'^2 > front then far else 0

時間方向のブロッキング（間隔 4）と，壁をまたぐ MPI 分割（半径を 3 分割の 3 プロセス，経度も分けた 6 プロセス）は，両座標系で通常の生成物を差 0 で再現し， 二つの座標系の生成 Formura ソースは double :: twist の行だけが異なります。ねじれ振動の厳密なモードには両座標系で次数 1.97，1.99（N = 16, 32, 64）で収束します （モードが軸対称で第二の座標系は経度をずらすだけなので，誤差は丸め誤差の範囲で一致します）。 壁に達する前に波速を測れる厚さ 2 の球殻（半径 1〜3，波源は半径 2）では，P 波と S 波の殻の外側の半径が球座標で 1.93 と 1.07，非直交座標で 1.90 と 1.06 の 速さで増え（厳密値 2 と 1。固定閾値は離散化された波面の縁を追います），二つの座標系は波面半径で 0.021 以内（外側の壁での経度方向の格子幅 0.074）， 平均半径で 0.008 以内，エネルギーで 10−7 以内で一致し，修正エネルギーのドリフトは 512 ステップで 8×10−14 です。論文の図のデモ（97×65×256 格子，1536 ステップ，10 プロセス）では，通常エネルギーの範囲は $[0.999993, 1]$，修正エネルギーのドリフトは 10−14 以下で，二つの座標系は波面半径で 0.017 以内，平均半径で 0.001 以内，エネルギーで 6×10−6 以内で一致し，赤道面の速さの場は t = 0.4 で相対 L² 差 7%（同じ物理点で比較，指標の場は導関数を含むので 20% 程度）です。
再生成：make elastic_shell-demo → python3 examples/elastic_shell/render.py。 追加検証：make elastic_shell-verify（ブロッキング／MPI の再現，生成ソースのパラメータ独立性，モードの収束，エネルギー，波面の速さ，二座標系の一致）。 説明と実行手順・ 検証数値と実行環境・ デモ実行の記録

周期領域の弾性波 — 直交座標と非直交座標で同じプログラム

一辺 4 の周期立方体で線形弾性体の波（速度と応力）を計算します。同じプログラムを、直交座標と、同じ立方体の非直交座標 （格子線が横に波打つ座標系、計量を成分で宣言）で実行します。λ = 2、μ = ρ0 = 1 なので P 波（圧縮波）の速さは 2、S 波（ずれの波）の速さは 1 で、 局所的な速度パルスは半径が 2t と t で増える二つの殻に分かれます。

128³ 格子で波源を通る平面。赤は P 波の指標 a|∇·v|/V0、青は S 波の指標 a|∇×v|/V0（平方根の色尺度、上限 0.2 と 0.5）。 破線円の半径は cPt と cSt、細線は 16 本ごとの格子線を物理位置に描いたもので、下段は同じ波が波打つ格子の上に現れます。 第 3 列は構成関数に 1 項 αninjnknlekl（α = 3、n = (1,1,0)/√2）を加えたもので、両方の波面が n に沿って伸びます。
eij = ½(gik∂jvk + gjk∂ivk + (∂kgij)vk)， ∇jσij = (gik/J)∂j(Jgklσlj) − ½gik(∂kgjl)σjl， ∂tσij = Cijklekl，Cijkl = λgijgkl + μ(gikgjl + gilgjk)
座標 (x, y, z) は物理位置 (x + s sin(2πy/L), y, z) に写します。計量は [[1, c, 0], [c, 1+c², 0], [0, 0, 1]]、 c = s(2π/L)cos(2πy/L)、det g = 1 で、二つの座標系の間で変わるのはパラメータ shear = s だけです。

三つの演算子は計量 g_i_j、逆計量 g~i~j、体積要素 volume、解析微分 ∂/∂ g_i_j coordinates~k をその場で使います。 Egison がコンパイル時にこれらを展開・簡約し、生成された時間ステップは残った係数をセルの座標から評価します（計量を格納する配列はありません）。 時間方向のブロッキングと 2 プロセスの MPI 分割は通常の生成物を厳密に再現します（ブロッキングされたステップの座標を誤っていた Formura のコード生成器は fork で修正済み）。評価に使う量はすべてプログラムの場です：二つの波の指標、 弾性エネルギーと速度 Verlet 法が保存する修正エネルギー、各殻の外側の半径（指標が 0.01 を超える点の距離の max reduction）、 平面 P 波・S 波の厳密解に対する誤差。ドライバは起動と記録だけを行い、render.py は保存した断面を物理位置に写して描きます。

-- Linear elastic waves (velocity-stress form) in a periodic box, written once
-- for a family of coordinate systems.  The coordinates (x, y, z) are mapped to
-- physical positions (x + shear * sin (wavenumber * y), y, z): shear = 0 is
-- Cartesian coordinates, shear > 0 a non-orthogonal chart of the same box
-- whose grid lines wave sideways.  Both directions stay periodic.
--
-- The metric of the map is declared by its components.  The operators use
-- the metric, its inverse, and its analytic derivatives in place: Egison
-- differentiates and simplifies them at compile time, and the generated
-- time step evaluates the resulting coefficients from the cell coordinates.
-- With lambda = 2, mu = rho0 = 1 the P-wave speed is 2 and the S-wave
-- speed is 1.
dimension 3
axes x, y, z
metric g
metric tensor [[1, shear * wavenumber * cos (wavenumber * y), 0], [shear * wavenumber * cos (wavenumber * y), 1 + (shear * wavenumber * cos (wavenumber * y))^2, 0], [0, 0, 1]]
metric volume 1

param λ = 2.0
param μ = 1.0
param ρ0 = 1.0
param dt = 0.1 * dx
param shear = 0.0
param wavenumber = 1.5707963267948966
param radius = 0.25
param x0 = 2.0
param y0 = 2.0
param z0 = 2.0
param cell = dx * dy * dz
param front = 0.0001
extern exp
extern sqrt

-- physical position along x, and the physical distance from the source
def physical = x + shear * sin (wavenumber * y)
def distance2 = (physical - x0)^2 + (y - y0)^2 + (z - z0)^2
-- the exponent is selected first, so that no overflowing value is formed;
-- the support stops at 0.995 radius (f < 1e-86 there), which keeps the
-- denominator positive under rounding of the expanded polynomials
def bump = if distance2 < 0.99 * radius^2 then 0 - 2 * distance2 / (radius^2 - distance2) else 0
def pulse = if distance2 < 0.99 * radius^2 then exp bump else 0
def strain V~a = withSymbols [i, j, k] ((g_i_k . ∂_j V~k + g_j_k . ∂_i V~k + (∂/∂ g_i_j coordinates~k) . V~k) / 2)
def stressRate E_i_j = withSymbols [i, j, k, l] (λ * g~i~j * (g~k~l . E_k_l) + 2 * μ * (g~i~k . g~j~l . E_k_l))
def stressDiv S~a~b = withSymbols [i, j, k, l] ((g~i~k . ∂_j (volume * (g_k_l . S~l~j))) / volume - (g~i~k . (∂/∂ g_j_l coordinates~k) . S~j~l) / 2)
-- coordinate-independent diagnostics of a velocity field
def waveDiv V~a = withSymbols [i] ((∂_i (volume * V~i)) / volume)
def waveCurl V~a = withSymbols [i, j, k, l] ((epsilon~i~j~k . ∂_j (g_k_l . V~l)) / volume)
def norm2 W~a = withSymbols [i, j] (g_i_j . W~i . W~j)
def stressNorm S~a~b = withSymbols [i, j, k, l] (g_i_k . g_j_l . S~i~j . S~k~l)
def stressTrace S~a~b = withSymbols [i, j] (g_i_j . S~i~j)

field v~i @ collocated
field σ{~i~j} @ collocated
field compression : scalar @ collocated
field shearing : scalar @ collocated
field energy : scalar @ collocated
field modified : scalar @ collocated
field pw : scalar @ collocated
field pr : scalar @ collocated
field sw : scalar @ collocated
field sr : scalar @ collocated
field pfront : scalar @ collocated
field sfront : scalar @ collocated

init:
  v~i := [| pulse, 0, 0 |]~i
  σ~i~j := [| [| 0, 0, 0 |], [| 0, 0, 0 |], [| 0, 0, 0 |] |]~i~j
  compression := 0
  shearing := 0
  energy := 0
  modified := 0
  pw := 0
  pr := 0
  sw := 0
  sr := 0
  pfront := 0
  sfront := 0

step:
  -- velocity Verlet: half velocity, full stress, half velocity
  local force~i @ collocated = stressDiv σ
  local half~i @ collocated = v~i + (dt / (2 * ρ0)) * force~i
  local e{_i_j} @ collocated = strain half
  local rate{~i~j} @ collocated = stressRate e
  σ'~i~j = σ~i~j + dt * rate~i~j
  local nextForce~i @ collocated = stressDiv σ'
  v'~i = half~i + (dt / (2 * ρ0)) * nextForce~i
  -- diagnostics of the state entering the step: P-wave indicator (divergence),
  -- S-wave indicator (norm of the curl), elastic energy, the energy that the
  -- Verlet step preserves, the moments of the P and S shells, and the physical
  -- distance from the source of the farthest point where the dimensionless
  -- indicator exceeds sqrt(front) (the outer edge of each shell, which
  -- advances at the wave speed)
  local far @ collocated = sqrt distance2
  compression' = waveDiv v
  local curlv~i @ collocated = waveCurl v
  shearing' = sqrt (norm2 curlv)
  energy' = cell * volume * (ρ0 * norm2 v / 2 + stressNorm σ / (4 * μ) - λ * (stressTrace σ)^2 / (4 * μ * (3 * λ + 2 * μ)))
  modified' = energy' - cell * volume * dt^2 * norm2 force / (8 * ρ0)
  pw' = cell * volume * compression'^2
  pr' = pw' * far
  sw' = cell * volume * shearing'^2
  sr' = sw' * far
  pfront' = if radius^2 * compression'^2 > front then far else 0
  sfront' = if radius^2 * shearing'^2 > front then far else 0

def FormuraeInternalEncodeTensor expectedShape variances degree value :=
  let actualVariances := Formurae.logicalTensorVariances value
      actualDegree := dfOrder value
      exactMetadata := actualVariances = variances && actualDegree = degree
      completesOmittedDownIndices := degree = 0
                                      && actualDegree > 0
                                      && actualVariances = variances

                   (tensorShape value = expectedShape
                    && (exactMetadata || completesOmittedDownIndices)) as bool with

時間方向のブロッキングと 2 プロセスの MPI 実行は、両座標系で通常の生成物を差 0 で再現し、二つの座標系の生成 Formura ソースは double :: shear の行だけが異なります。平面 P 波・S 波の厳密解には両座標系で次数 1.95〜1.99（N = 16, 32, 64）で収束します。 128³ 格子では P 波と S 波の殻の外側の半径が直交座標で 1.86 と 0.96、非直交座標で 1.86 と 0.95 の速さで増え（厳密値 2 と 1。 パルスの縁は最も短い波長を含み、中心差分はそれを遅く伝えます）、二つの座標系は 0.007（格子幅 0.031）以内で一致し、 修正エネルギーのドリフトは 256 ステップで 4×10−13 です。
再生成：make elastic_pulse-demo → python3 examples/elastic_pulse/render.py。 追加検証：make elastic_pulse-verify（ブロッキング／MPI の再現、生成ソースのパラメータ独立性、平面波の収束、エネルギー、波面の速さ、二座標系の一致）。 説明と実行手順・ 検証数値と実行環境・ デモ実行の記録

Δu = (1/r)∂r(r∂ru) + (1/r²)∂φφu, r ∈ [1,2]  曲率 0 — 曲がっているのは座標だけ

-- Heat equation on a PLANAR ANNULUS in polar coordinates
-- (r_phys, phi) = (1 + r, phi), r_phys in [1, 2].  The geometry is
-- flat (curvature 0) -- only the COORDINATES are curved: from the
-- embedding the CAS derives g = diag(1, (1+r)^2), i.e. the textbook
-- polar Laplacian (1/r) d_r (r d_r u) + (1/r^2) d_phiphi u, assembled
-- as an exactly conservative flux form.  The r walls are Neumann
-- (mirror), phi is periodic.

dimension 3
axes r, φ, z

param dt = 0.0001

embedding [ `(1 + r) * cos φ, `(1 + r) * sin φ, z ]

field u : scalar @ primal

init:
  u := exp (0 - 4 * (r - 1 / 2) ^ 2) * exp (cos φ - 1)

step:
  u' = u + dt * Δ u

dimension :: 3
axes :: r,phi,z

double :: dt = 0.0001

extern function :: cos
extern function :: exp

begin function (u,deltaCoeff_1,deltaCoeff_2,deltaCoeff_3) = init()
  double [] :: u, deltaCoeff_1, deltaCoeff_2, deltaCoeff_3
  u[i,j,k] = exp((-2) + (-4) * (dr * i)**2 + 4 * dr * i + cos(dphi * j))
  deltaCoeff_1[i,j,k] = 1 + dr * ((1 / 2) + i)
  deltaCoeff_2[i,j,k] = 1 / (1 + dr * i)
  deltaCoeff_3[i,j,k] = 1 + dr * i
end function

begin function (u',deltaCoeff_1',deltaCoeff_2',deltaCoeff_3') = step(u,deltaCoeff_1,deltaCoeff_2,deltaCoeff_3)
  double [] :: u', deltaCoeff_1', deltaCoeff_2', deltaCoeff_3'
  deltaCoeff_1'[i,j,k] = deltaCoeff_1[i,j,k]
  deltaCoeff_2'[i,j,k] = deltaCoeff_2[i,j,k]
  deltaCoeff_3'[i,j,k] = deltaCoeff_3[i,j,k]
  deltaFlux_1[i,j,k] = deltaCoeff_1[i,j,k] * (u[i+1,j,k] + (-1) * u[i,j,k]) / dr
  deltaFlux_2[i,j,k] = deltaCoeff_2[i,j,k] * (u[i,j+1,k] + (-1) * u[i,j,k]) / dphi
  deltaFlux_3[i,j,k] = deltaCoeff_3[i,j,k] * (u[i,j,k+1] + (-1) * u[i,j,k]) / dz
  u'[i,j,k] = (u[i,j,k] + dr * i * u[i,j,k] + dt * (deltaFlux_1[i,j,k] + (-1) * deltaFlux_1[i-1,j,k]) / dr + dt * (deltaFlux_2[i,j,k] + (-1) * deltaFlux_2[i,j-1,k]) / dphi + dt * (deltaFlux_3[i,j,k] + (-1) * deltaFlux_3[i,j,k-1]) / dz) / (1 + dr * i)
end function

-- Heat equation in FULL 3D SPHERICAL COORDINATES, on a shell:
-- (r_phys, theta_phys, phi) = (1 + r, 1 + theta, phi),
-- r_phys in [1, 2], theta_phys in [1, 1 + L] (poles avoided).
-- All three axes are nontrivial.  From the embedding the CAS derives
-- g = diag(1, (1+r)^2, (1+r)^2 sin^2(1+theta)) -- the spherical
-- Laplacian -- checks orthogonality symbolically, and assembles the
-- conservative flux form.  Both r and theta walls are Neumann
-- (mirror), phi is periodic.

dimension 3
axes r, θ, φ

param dt = 0.0002

embedding [ `(1 + r) * sin (1 + θ) * cos φ, `(1 + r) * sin (1 + θ) * sin φ, `(1 + r) * cos (1 + θ) ]

field u : scalar @ primal

init:
  u := exp (0 - 4 * (r - 1 / 2) ^ 2) * exp (0 - 4 * (θ - 1 / 2) ^ 2) * exp (cos φ - 1)

step:
  u' = u + dt * Δ u

def FormuraeInternalEncodeTensor expectedShape variances degree value :=
  let actualVariances := Formurae.logicalTensorVariances value
      actualDegree := dfOrder value
      exactMetadata := actualVariances = variances && actualDegree = degree
      completesOmittedDownIndices := degree = 0
                                      && actualDegree > 0
                                      && actualVariances = variances
   in match assert "normalized equation tensor metadata mismatch"
                   (tensorShape value = expectedShape
                    && (exactMetadata || completesOmittedDownIndices)) as bool with
        | #True -> FEIR.encodeTensorWithMetadata feParameters feCoordinatesRegistry feFields feIntrinsics feAnalytics variances degree value

def FormuraeInternalEncodeTensorFromValue value :=
  if tensorShape value = []
    then FEIR.list [FEIR.atom "scalar", FEIR.encodeScalar feParameters feCoordinatesRegistry feFields feIntrinsics feAnalytics value]
    else FEIR.list [FEIR.atom "tensor-value", FEIR.encodeTensorWithMetadata feParameters feCoordinatesRegistry feFields feIntrinsics feAnalytics (Formurae.logicalTensorVariances value) (dfOrder value) value]

  deltaCoeff_3[i,j,k] = (2 * dr * i * sin(1 + dtheta * j)**(-1) + (dr * i)**2 * sin(1 + dtheta * j)**(-1) + sin(1 + dtheta * j)**(-1)) / (1 + 2 * dr * i + (dr * i)**2)
end function

  deltaCoeff_2'[i,j,k] = deltaCoeff_2[i,j,k]
  deltaCoeff_3'[i,j,k] = deltaCoeff_3[i,j,k]

∂tu = (1/√g) ∂i(√g gij ∂ju)

-- Heat equation on a curved surface (a torus), from the COORDINATES:
-- the embedding of the (theta, phi, z) chart into R^4 below is the
-- only geometric input.  The compiler differentiates it (CAS), forms
-- the metric g_ab = dX/dx_a . dX/dx_b, checks orthogonality
-- symbolically (generation is gated on g_12 = g_13 = g_23 = 0),
-- takes the scale factors h_a = sqrt(g_aa), evaluates the hodge
-- factors sqrt(g)/h_a^2 at the half-cell placements, freezes them
-- into coefficient fields, and lowers the canonical scalar Δ to an
-- exactly conservative flux form.
--
-- Backquotes keep `(2 + cos θ) atomic during the CAS work
-- (sin^2 + cos^2 collapses to 1, sqrt of the quoted square reduces),
-- and quote-transparent substitution keeps the reduced factor compact.

dimension 3
axes θ, φ, z

param dt = 0.0005

embedding [ `(2 + cos θ) * cos φ, `(2 + cos θ) * sin φ, sin θ, z ]

field u : scalar @ primal

init:
  u := exp (cos θ + cos φ - 2)

step:
  u' = u + dt * Δ u

dimension :: 3
axes :: theta,phi,z

double :: dt = 0.0005

extern function :: cos
extern function :: exp

begin function (u,deltaCoeff_1,deltaCoeff_2,deltaCoeff_3) = init()
  double [] :: u, deltaCoeff_1, deltaCoeff_2, deltaCoeff_3
  u[i,j,k] = exp((-2) + cos(dphi * j) + cos(dtheta * i))
  deltaCoeff_1[i,j,k] = 2 + cos(dtheta * ((1 / 2) + i))
  deltaCoeff_2[i,j,k] = 1 / (2 + cos(dtheta * i))
  deltaCoeff_3[i,j,k] = 2 + cos(dtheta * i)
end function

begin function (u',deltaCoeff_1',deltaCoeff_2',deltaCoeff_3') = step(u,deltaCoeff_1,deltaCoeff_2,deltaCoeff_3)
  double [] :: u', deltaCoeff_1', deltaCoeff_2', deltaCoeff_3'
  deltaCoeff_1'[i,j,k] = deltaCoeff_1[i,j,k]
  deltaCoeff_2'[i,j,k] = deltaCoeff_2[i,j,k]
  deltaCoeff_3'[i,j,k] = deltaCoeff_3[i,j,k]
  deltaFlux_1[i,j,k] = deltaCoeff_1[i,j,k] * (u[i+1,j,k] + (-1) * u[i,j,k]) / dtheta
  deltaFlux_2[i,j,k] = deltaCoeff_2[i,j,k] * (u[i,j+1,k] + (-1) * u[i,j,k]) / dphi
  deltaFlux_3[i,j,k] = deltaCoeff_3[i,j,k] * (u[i,j,k+1] + (-1) * u[i,j,k]) / dz
  u'[i,j,k] = (2 * u[i,j,k] + dt * (deltaFlux_1[i,j,k] + (-1) * deltaFlux_1[i-1,j,k]) / dtheta + dt * (deltaFlux_2[i,j,k] + (-1) * deltaFlux_2[i,j-1,k]) / dphi + dt * (deltaFlux_3[i,j,k] + (-1) * deltaFlux_3[i,j,k-1]) / dz + u[i,j,k] * cos(dtheta * i)) / (2 + cos(dtheta * i))
end function
トーラス上に描いた u(t=0 → 3000、陰影つき3D)の時間発展
独立 C 参照と 3.3e-16(全桁一致)・計量重みつき熱量 Σ√g·u 保存 2.5e-15・ 最大値原理成立。スケール因子導出版の .fmr は手展開版とバイト一致。

球面の帯(正曲率)

∂tu = ΔS²u,  余緯度 θ ∈ [1, 1+L] の帯
埋め込みから g=diag(1, sin²θ) を CAS が導出、θ 壁は mirror(Neumann)
Formurae ソース全文(metric_sphere.fme・23 行) 
-- Heat equation on a BAND OF THE UNIT SPHERE (positive curvature),
-- colatitude theta_phys = 1 + theta in [1, 1 + L] (poles avoided).
-- The embedding below is the only geometric input: the compiler
-- derives g = diag(1, sin^2(1+theta)) via the CAS (sin^2+cos^2
-- collapses, sqrt of the square closes), checks orthogonality, and
-- assembles the conservative Laplace-Beltrami flux form.  The theta
-- walls are Neumann (yaml boundary: mirror), so the metric-weighted
-- heat sum(sin(1+theta) u) is exactly conserved.

dimension 3
axes θ, φ, z

param dt = 0.0001

embedding [ sin (1 + θ) * cos φ, sin (1 + θ) * sin φ, cos (1 + θ), z ]

field u : scalar @ primal

init:
  u := exp (0 - 4 * (θ - 1 / 2) ^ 2) * exp (cos φ - 1)

step:
  u' = u + dt * Δ u

dimension :: 3
axes :: theta,phi,z

double :: dt = 0.0001

extern function :: sin
extern function :: cos
extern function :: exp

begin function (u,deltaCoeff_1,deltaCoeff_2,deltaCoeff_3) = init()
  double [] :: u, deltaCoeff_1, deltaCoeff_2, deltaCoeff_3
  u[i,j,k] = exp((-2) + (-4) * (dtheta * i)**2 + 4 * dtheta * i + cos(dphi * j))
  deltaCoeff_1[i,j,k] = sin(1 + dtheta * ((1 / 2) + i))
  deltaCoeff_2[i,j,k] = sin(1 + dtheta * i)**(-1)
  deltaCoeff_3[i,j,k] = sin(1 + dtheta * i)
end function

begin function (u',deltaCoeff_1',deltaCoeff_2',deltaCoeff_3') = step(u,deltaCoeff_1,deltaCoeff_2,deltaCoeff_3)
  double [] :: u', deltaCoeff_1', deltaCoeff_2', deltaCoeff_3'
  deltaCoeff_1'[i,j,k] = deltaCoeff_1[i,j,k]
  deltaCoeff_2'[i,j,k] = deltaCoeff_2[i,j,k]
  deltaCoeff_3'[i,j,k] = deltaCoeff_3[i,j,k]
  deltaFlux_1[i,j,k] = deltaCoeff_1[i,j,k] * (u[i+1,j,k] + (-1) * u[i,j,k]) / dtheta
  deltaFlux_2[i,j,k] = deltaCoeff_2[i,j,k] * (u[i,j+1,k] + (-1) * u[i,j,k]) / dphi
  deltaFlux_3[i,j,k] = deltaCoeff_3[i,j,k] * (u[i,j,k+1] + (-1) * u[i,j,k]) / dz
  u'[i,j,k] = u[i,j,k] + dt * (deltaFlux_1[i,j,k] + (-1) * deltaFlux_1[i-1,j,k]) / dtheta * sin(1 + dtheta * i)**(-1) + dt * (deltaFlux_2[i,j,k] + (-1) * deltaFlux_2[i,j-1,k]) / dphi * sin(1 + dtheta * i)**(-1) + dt * (deltaFlux_3[i,j,k] + (-1) * deltaFlux_3[i,j,k-1]) / dz * sin(1 + dtheta * i)**(-1)
end function

-- Heat equation on the POINCARE HALF-PLANE (constant NEGATIVE
-- curvature -1): ds^2 = (dx^2 + dy^2) / y_phys^2 with
-- y_phys = 1 + y in [1, 2].  A genuinely non-Euclidean geometry that
-- admits no embedding into R^3, so the metric is given directly by
-- its scale factors; the compiler derives sqrt(g) = 1/(1+y)^2 and the
-- hodge factors (both 1 -- the hyperbolic Laplacian is
-- (1+y)^2 (u_xx + u_yy)) and assembles the conservative flux form.
-- The y walls are Neumann (mirror), x is periodic.

dimension 3
axes x, y, z

param dt = 0.00002

metric scale [ 1 / (1 + y), 1 / (1 + y), 1 ]

field u : scalar @ primal

init:
  u := exp (cos x - 1) * exp (0 - 4 * (y - 1 / 2) ^ 2)

step:
  u' = u + dt * Δ u

生成された Formura 全文(hyperbolic.fmr・26 行) 
dimension :: 3
axes :: x,y,z

double :: dt = 0.00002

extern function :: cos
extern function :: exp

begin function (u,deltaCoeff_1,deltaCoeff_2,deltaCoeff_3) = init()
  double [] :: u, deltaCoeff_1, deltaCoeff_2, deltaCoeff_3
  u[i,j,k] = exp((-2) + (-4) * (dy * j)**2 + 4 * dy * j + cos(dx * i))
  deltaCoeff_1[i,j,k] = 1
  deltaCoeff_2[i,j,k] = 1
  deltaCoeff_3[i,j,k] = 1 / (1 + 2 * dy * j + (dy * j)**2)
end function

begin function (u',deltaCoeff_1',deltaCoeff_2',deltaCoeff_3') = step(u,deltaCoeff_1,deltaCoeff_2,deltaCoeff_3)
  double [] :: u', deltaCoeff_1', deltaCoeff_2', deltaCoeff_3'
  deltaCoeff_1'[i,j,k] = deltaCoeff_1[i,j,k]
  deltaCoeff_2'[i,j,k] = deltaCoeff_2[i,j,k]
  deltaCoeff_3'[i,j,k] = deltaCoeff_3[i,j,k]
  deltaFlux_1[i,j,k] = deltaCoeff_1[i,j,k] * (u[i+1,j,k] + (-1) * u[i,j,k]) / dx
  deltaFlux_2[i,j,k] = deltaCoeff_2[i,j,k] * (u[i,j+1,k] + (-1) * u[i,j,k]) / dy
  deltaFlux_3[i,j,k] = deltaCoeff_3[i,j,k] * (u[i,j,k+1] + (-1) * u[i,j,k]) / dz
  u'[i,j,k] = u[i,j,k] + 2 * dt * dy * j * (deltaFlux_1[i,j,k] + (-1) * deltaFlux_1[i-1,j,k]) / dx + 2 * dt * dy * j * (deltaFlux_2[i,j,k] + (-1) * deltaFlux_2[i,j-1,k]) / dy + 2 * dt * dy * j * (deltaFlux_3[i,j,k] + (-1) * deltaFlux_3[i,j,k-1]) / dz + dt * (deltaFlux_1[i,j,k] + (-1) * deltaFlux_1[i-1,j,k]) / dx + dt * (deltaFlux_1[i,j,k] + (-1) * deltaFlux_1[i-1,j,k]) / dx * (dy * j)**2 + dt * (deltaFlux_2[i,j,k] + (-1) * deltaFlux_2[i,j-1,k]) / dy + dt * (deltaFlux_2[i,j,k] + (-1) * deltaFlux_2[i,j-1,k]) / dy * (dy * j)**2 + dt * (deltaFlux_3[i,j,k] + (-1) * deltaFlux_3[i,j,k-1]) / dz + dt * (deltaFlux_3[i,j,k] + (-1) * deltaFlux_3[i,j,k-1]) / dz * (dy * j)**2
end function
半平面チャート上の u(t=0 → 0.1): 上端(y 大)ほど実効拡散 y² が速い
独立参照実装と 6.7e-16・Σu/y² 保存 9.8e-16・最大値原理成立。

Yin-Yang overset — 球面全域(2 パネル 1 カーネル)

∂tu = ΔS²u(単位球面の Laplace–Beltrami)
Formurae ソース全文(yinyang_diffusion.fme・33 行) 
-- Heat equation on ONE PANEL of the Yin-Yang overset grid for the
-- FULL unit sphere (Kageyama & Sato 2004).  A panel is the low-latitude
-- lon-lat rectangle theta_phys = 5π/24 + theta with
--   theta_phys in [π/4 - 2h, 3π/4 + 2h],  phi in [-3π/4 - 2h, 3π/4 + 2h],
-- h = π/48: the classical minimal panel extended by a 2-cell
-- interpolation margin.  Yin and Yang are
-- congruent under the involution (x,y,z) -> (-x,z,y), so this single
-- program is the kernel for BOTH panels: the check driver instantiates
-- the generated grid twice and, after every step, overwrites the
-- one-cell rim of each panel with bilinear interpolation from the
-- other panel -- the overset boundary condition.  The yaml walls are
-- mirror only as a placeholder; the rim cells they influence are
-- exactly the cells the driver overwrites.  The init below is the
-- global eigenmode Y_1^0 = cos(theta_global) in Yin coordinates
-- (theta_global = theta_phys on Yin).  The local phi origin is
-- phi0 = -19π/24, matching the check driver.  The
-- driver rewrites both panels with each of the three global l=1
-- Cartesian modes in turn, and checks their exact decay e^{-2t}.

dimension 3
axes θ, φ, z

param dt = 0.0003

embedding [ sin (5 * π / 24 + θ) * cos (φ - 19 * π / 24), sin (5 * π / 24 + θ) * sin (φ - 19 * π / 24), cos (5 * π / 24 + θ), z ]

field u : scalar @ primal

init:
  u := cos (5 * π / 24 + θ)

step:
  u' = u + dt * Δ u
同じ物理的なガウス塊を Yin(左)は φ 端で、Yang(右)は θ 端で見る(2 パネルは対合 (x,y,z)→(−x,z,y) で合同)。t=0.18までに熱が 継ぎ目の縁補間を通って Yang 内部へ流れ込み、パネル境界に不連続が見えない。 色スケールは全フレームで両パネル共有
.fme は1 パネル分のカーネルだけ(compiler 無改造)。check driver が 格子構造体を 2 個持って formura_data に交互に差し替え、毎 step 後に相手パネルから 1 セル縁を双一次補間で上書き。検証は大域 l=1 固有モード x/y/z の厳密減衰 e−2t・パネル間一致・最大値原理。
formurae — Egison (テンソル添字記法+CAS) × Formura (分散ステンシル、temporal blocking)。 数値の検証は make all と、興奮波の追加検証 make excitable_torus-verify で再現できます。
